about: S4 task 8.7 / S4-IR-02: the handwritten scheduling for every open item the closeout check assembles. Joined by id onto the generated items in tools/requirements-register.json (open) and tools/test-classification.json (coupledOnly), so rebuilding either register erases no assignment. Entries with origin "handwritten" are items no generator discovers. Every entry cites its basis; fields eb proposed say so in their basis. The owner reviewed and approved this schedule and its task map on 2026-09-13 (tools/closeout-task-map.json review). Edited by hand: run node tools/closeout-check.js after any change.

entries.basis: S4 task 10.5 is open, for the owner. A page for this engine was built from c4d2a93 with a 5 s stall limit (the owner, 2026-09-13, round 5 decision 17). The owner then decided the same day not to benchmark this engine on Android: the rebuilt engine will be measured instead. So S6 task 2 records Android as unmeasured for this engine, task 5 carries it as a risk beside the iPhone, and the device measurement moves to the rebuilt engine (S6_TASK_CHECKLIST.md 7.3b). Proposed by eb and approved by the owner on 2026-09-13: severity high, because Android is the primary device and the budget rests on it.
